data.title: Hover
data.tagline: Respond when a pointer rests over an interactive element
data.description: Hover can preview that an item is interactive or reveal secondary detail before a click. It does not exist on touch-only devices, so essential content and actions must remain available without it. Keep the visual change clear but stable.

use: Support pointer users with an extra cue
avoid: Hide essential actions behind hover only
Move the target so much that it becomes hard to click
Apply hover styling to non-interactive content

lessonPractice.title: A card's Delete action appears only on mouse hover, so touch and keyboard users cannot find it. What should change?

options.label: Keep hover-only visibility but make the action appear faster
options.feedback: Speed does not help touch devices without hover or keyboard users who never move a pointer over the card.

options.label: Keep restrained hover feedback and also support focus and touch access
options.feedback: Hover can reinforce mouse interaction, but an important action also needs discoverable keyboard and touch paths.

options.label: Keep hover on desktop and remove the Delete action on mobile
options.feedback: Removing the action prevents mobile users from completing the same task instead of providing a touch-friendly entry.

data.agentPrompt: Keep a restrained card hover state, but do not expose Delete only on hover. Make it discoverable through keyboard focus and a touch-friendly menu without jumpy movement. Complete the delete confirmation with mouse, Tab, and mobile touch.
